title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics, parity bump v1.43.0
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Motivation: Align auth/retry behavior and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs to reduce customer confusion and surface consistent error semantics. This PR: 1) Introduces a shared AuthManager abstraction in each SDK that centralizes token refresh + retry hooks; 2) Standardizes retry policies and default backoff parameters across SDKs; 3) Reworks streaming APIs to provide ergonomic async iterators (TS/Python) and parity stream semantics (Go) so code patterns match cross-language samples; 4) Adds cross-SDK e2e tests and docs; 5) Bumps SDK versions to v1.43.0 and updates changelogs. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-8921) - [x] Implement Python auth + retry middleware - [x] Implement TS streaming iterator and retry wiring - [x] Update Go transport and stream client parity - [x] Add e2e streaming tests (flaky guarded) - [x] Update SDK CHANGELOGs and migration guide - [x] CI green after re-run Notes: Migration is backwards-compatible for most users; a small surface-area change is the behavior of streaming on early auth failures (now surfaces consistent Cancelled/401 semantics instead of silent reconnect). See docs/sdk-migration.md for recommended changes. This description is a single continuous string with the above sections combined into one block for PR metadata consumption.
